headers.description: Optional. Public tools need no sign-in. Account tools ask the client to sign in with OAuth (discovery at https://requstory.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp/lab); clients without OAuth can send "Bearer rqs_…", a key from the Requstory profile.
